name: [SEASON 1 🌟] Car Sales 2 🏎️
desc:
Welcome to Car Sales 2! 🏎️💸
A car flipping game based in the middle east 🗺️
Buy at the lowest price, repair and modify, then sell at the highest price! 💸
Build your own dealership, make deals with players, collect rare cars, and race to the finish line! 🏁

What can you do here?
💼 Negotiate and hunt for the best deals
🔧 Repair and upgrade your car to increase profits
🏎️ Customize your car and join races
🏢 Improve and expand your dealership for better offers
🤝 Trade with players to get limited-edition cars
⭐ Compete to top the leaderboards and become the ultimate car dealer in the city

Stuck? The shop helps you progress faster! 🛒
Developed by Red Monster Studios 👺

Tags:
Hajwala, Car Dealer, Car Buying and Selling, Car Customization, Car Map, Races, Rare Cars
